notes.title: Aerodynamics and Hit Registration Update
notes.notes:
Greetings, pilots!

A new update is now available — it brings a series of technical and gameplay improvements, and sets the stage for a major upcoming update. 

Here's what's been added:

🎥 Camera Angle and FOV
When adjusted, the camera angle and field of view (FOV) are displayed in the interface. You can also set default values for both parameters in the settings.

💨 Propwash Effect
A basic simulation of the propwash effect has been added — flights now feel a bit more realistic.

🎯 Improved Hit Registration System
The accuracy of hit detection on vehicles and objects has been significantly improved.

💥 Shaped Charge Jet Mechanics
Vehicle damage now depends on the direction of the explosion. The damage may be significantly reduced if the shaped charge is not aimed directly at the target. Choosing the right attack angle is key to maximizing damage.

🛠️ Bug Fixes and Stability Improvements
Many issues have been fixed to improve game stability.

🔧 What's Next?
I’m already working on a major update that will introduce electronic warfare (EW) systems and dynamic vehicle armor (grill cages). It's coming soon — stay tuned!

Thank you to everyone helping to make this project better!

notes.title: Bug Fixes & Optimization
notes.notes:
Greetings, pilots!
A new version is now available, bringing many important improvements and fixes. 
Here's what’s been done:

🎮 DJI FPV Controllers
Fixed compatibility issues with DJI FPV controllers.
DJI FPV 3 controllers may still experience some instability — please report any issues in the Steam community!

🛡️ Balance and Bug Fixes
Shilka no longer shoots through objects.
Improved hit registration when attacking vehicles with drones.
Fixed an issue where altitude changes didn’t affect signal quality.

📈 Optimized video memory usage.
🔧 Multiple bug fixes and stability improvements.

Thanks to everyone in the community for reporting bugs and helping with testing — you're the best! If you encounter issues or want to share an idea, please post in the game's Steam community.

See you in the next update — more exciting things are on the way! 🚀
